description: Defines the FormattableMarkup class for safely formatting strings with placeholders for HTML display, including methods for placeholder replacement, escaping, and serialization.

classes.name: FormattableMarkup
classes.description: A class for formatting strings with placeholders, escaping values for safe HTML display, and supporting count and JSON serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a string containing placeholders and an array of arguments.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the formatted string with placeholders replaced.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the length of the string.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the string content for JSON serialization.
